page.layout: One page of running text in one column, with no marginal notes. Top: running head "J. M. SUARESIUS." with page number 282. main_text.head: EPIST. XXXII.
main_text.p: Joh. Morinus Suaresio, suum de frag-mento quodam Tertuliani nuper e-dito, judicium interp[?]nit, similiter de excepto quodam ex Epistola S. Maximi ad Monachos Siculos.

Litteras tuas accepi, simulque Orationes duas, quas coram summo Pontifice habuisti. Utramque statim avide legi, nobilissimamque materiam eloquentia tua exæquante, avidius relegi. Dignissimæ Sedis Apostolicæ Bibliothecario orationes, dignissima maximi inge-

page.notes: Catchword "nii" is the start of the next line, "ingenii". The date "CID ID CXXXI" was read as CIↃ IↃ CXXXI (M, D, CXXXI) = MDCXXXI. Doubtful: "interp[?]nit" (a mark between "interp" and "nit" makes the word unclear). Long s and the ligatures qv/æ were normalised per the rules; "verùm" keeps the printed accent as it appears on the scan. The "Joh." initial is set in a larger face and is marked as italic.
